Default: 4."
"5. Knowledge retrieval (returned)"
"5. Knowledge retrieval (returned)"

literalChanges.before: "Maximum people, places, clans, and kingdoms injected into each AI request. Terms receive distinct entity slots by preprocessing importance; unused slots are filled only when the limit exceeds the term count. Default: 6."
literalChanges.after: "Maximum people, places, clans, and kingdoms injected into each AI request. In preprocessing importance order, each term first occupies one highest-scoring entity slot. For people with the same name, a clan explicitly specified by another term takes priority, followed by a kingdom. Their actual campaign-map distance from the current NPC then adds a small bonus of up to 0.15; the final score may exceed 1.00. If scope or position is unavailable, the original score is used. If the highest-scoring entity is already occupied by an earlier term, the first unoccupied entity is used instead. Secondary results are added only when the limit exceeds the term count: first up to 3 for the earliest term, then for subsequent terms in order. Default: 6."

literalChanges.before: "Configure Proactive NPC Request Prisoner Ratio Threshold Percent."

"When enabled, kingdoms publish diplomatic declarations, negotiate, and take diplomatic actions on their own. Diplomacy and scribe drafting reuse the event and kingdom-rebellion API, falling back to the main API if the configuration is incomplete. When disabled, native kingdom diplomatic decisions resume."
"Applies only to newly created saves, ending kingdom wars already present at the start. Disabled by default; toggling this does not reset wars in the current save."

"Delivered diplomatic declarations appear as text messages at the bottom left, instead of right-side notifications. Disabling this does not affect negotiations, distribution, bulletin material, or kingdom notices."

literalChanges.before: "Configure World Diplomacy Maximum Concurrent Ordinary Rounds."
literalChanges.after: "Shared by ordinary automatic diplomacy and policy triggers; default: 3 events. When full, policy work remains pending while existing talks continue replying and finish. Lowering the limit does not cancel existing events. At most 1 additional event opens per day; player diplomacy and verbal-promise events do not use these slots."

"Low: at most 2 kingdoms; moderate: at most 3; high: at most 5, all including the initiating kingdom. Selects only kingdoms with actual diplomatic matters and does not fill the count artificially. Default: moderate. This is the participant count for one event, not the number of concurrent events."

"Typical end time for new events: compact about 15 days, standard about 21 days, relaxed about 28 days. Events may finish early on reaching an outcome or extend briefly to conclude. Default: standard; affects only new events."

literalChanges.before: "Configure World Diplomacy Court Maximum Delivery Days."
literalChanges.after: "Allocates court delivery times by distance. Controls delivery to the farthest court and the relay pace for one round of a new event; not every kingdom waits this fixed number of days. Default: 7 days; lower values produce more frequent replies."

"Schedules when local nobles and civilians learn of diplomatic declarations according to distance. Default: 21 days. Does not control how often events automatically start or replace court delivery times."

"Shared length range for AI-generated diplomatic declarations, responses, and scribe drafts, including punctuation. Default minimum: 100 characters; adjustable from 1 to 1000. Does not limit player-written edits."

"Shared length range for AI-generated diplomatic declarations, responses, and scribe drafts, including punctuation. Default maximum: 500 characters; adjustable from 1 to 1000. Values below the minimum length are treated as the minimum. Does not limit player-written edits."

literalChanges.before: "Open the editor or run this action."
literalChanges.after: "Edits diplomatic judgment and style preferences. Scribe drafting uses the style requirements to expand the existing player text faithfully without adding substantive terms on its own. A blank value adds no preferences; fixed fact boundaries and output rules remain in force."

literalChanges.before: "Open the editor or run this action."
literalChanges.after: "Restores the mod default preference text after confirmation. Restores only text preferences; does not reset this page event limits, distribution, length, or protection-period settings."

literalChanges.before: "Configure World Diplomacy Offensive War Cooldown Days."
literalChanges.after: "Minimum days after a kingdom starts a war before it can initiate another new war. Default: 42 days. Does not limit publication frequency for other diplomatic declarations."

"After two kingdoms make peace, ordinary diplomatic disputes cannot restart war during this period. Default: 21 days; 0 disables this protection. Other war-declaration eligibility restrictions are unaffected."

literalChanges.before: "Configure World Diplomacy Trade Alliance Failed Proposal Cooldown Days."
literalChanges.after: "After a trade or alliance proposal fails, the same proposing kingdom temporarily cannot make the same type of proposal to the same target. Reverse-direction proposals and the other proposal type are tracked separately. Default: 168 days; 0 disables this."

literalChanges.before: "Configure World Diplomacy Threat Compliance Issuer Relation Reward."
literalChanges.after: "After the target kingdom explicitly complies with a condemnation or ultimatum, leaders of the issuing kingdom formal, non-mercenary vassal clans gain this relation with the current king. Settled only once per threat. Default: 10; 0 disables the reward."

literalChanges.before: "Configure World Diplomacy History Compression Trigger Thousands."
literalChanges.after: "Start batched compression when the long-term diplomacy archive reaches this estimated size. Default: 800 (about 800k tokens); controls backlog and frequency, not history carried by each declaration. Total declaration input has a separate 32k estimated-token cap, and each compression batch has a separate 128k input cap."

literalChanges.before: "Configure World Diplomacy History Compression Target Thousands."
literalChanges.after: "Combined target for the long-term snapshot and protected facts after each compression batch. Default: 48, about 48k tokens; cap: 60k. Declarations take only relevant material, not the whole snapshot. Actual summaries are also limited by the selected API maximum output tokens."

"Master gathering-system switch. Disabling it stops new gatherings; ongoing gatherings are settled as cancelled at the next safe campaign hour, and hosts and guests are scheduled to return home. No game restart is required."
"When enabled, eligible NPCs automatically host gatherings by kingdom. Disabling it stops automatic creation of NPC gatherings; the player can still host gatherings."
"When enabled, NPC gatherings can invite the player and send a courier. Disabling this blocks only new invitations; invitations already sent to the player remain valid."
"Controls colored messages at the bottom left when guests arrive at a player-hosted gathering. Disabling it hides only the messages; arrival checks, gathering state, and rewards are unaffected."
"In-game days between scheduling two automatic gatherings in the same kingdom. Default: 21 days. Calculated separately per kingdom; changes are used the next time a gathering is rescheduled."
"Affects only automatically generated NPC guest lists. When disabled, NPCs do not invite governors currently governing settlements; players hosting gatherings can still invite governors freely."
"Shared by player and NPC gatherings. Default: 5 days. Changes affect only gatherings created afterward; gatherings already underway keep their original end date."
"Shared by player and NPC hosts; the actual host pays the cost. Default: 50000 denars; 0 means free."

literalChanges.before: "Configure Noble Gathering Invited Clan Relation Reward."
literalChanges.after: "Shared by player and NPC gatherings; settled only once per gathering for the host and each invited clan leader. Default: 5; 0 means no relation increase. Changes affect only gatherings created afterward."
"Choose weekly reports or bulletins; the two modes are mutually exclusive. Switching modes preserves historical archives."
"Disabling this stops new bulletin generation, while recent events are still recorded for NPC awareness. Independent of automatic weekly-report generation."

literalChanges.before: "Open the editor or run this action."
literalChanges.after: "Edits immediate-bulletin writing requirements separately; applies to the next request. Clearing them retains the built-in format and fact constraints."
"1 = 200–400 characters; 2 = 200–800 characters; 3 = 200–1200 characters; 4 = 200–1500 characters. Shared by world and kingdom weekly reports. Default: 2."
"Limits the weekly-report generation request rate during development. Default: 5; maximum 20. Helps accommodate RPM or concurrency limits of some API channels."

"When enabled, the system automatically settles the previous week at the start of each new week and generates world and kingdom weekly reports. On day 0, the opening overview is automatically recorded as a week 0 event."

literalChanges.before: "Configure Weekly Report Popup Body Font Size."
literalChanges.after: "Affects only the body of the large popup for the latest kingdom weekly report, not other interfaces. Default: 18."

"When enabled, a clickable message appears at the bottom right of the campaign map when a weekly report is generated. When disabled, no message appears, and reports generated while disabled are not queued for later notification. Enabled by default."

"When enabled, opening a weekly report from a map notification and staying for 10 full seconds accumulates experience from the character counts of its three columns. After every 20 reports studied, Charm, Leadership, and Steward experience is awarded to the player in one batch."

literalChanges.before: "Configure Weekly Report Reading XP Per Hundred Chars."
literalChanges.after: "Length multiplier for weekly-report reading rewards. Default: 20, meaning 20 experience in the corresponding skill per 100 valid characters/words in each column."

literalChanges.before: "Configure Weekly Report Reading XP Skill Cap."
literalChanges.after: "Maximum experience per skill from one weekly report. Default: 100; 0 disables weekly-report reading experience."
"When disabled, this mod no longer triggers kingdom rebellions. Kingdom stability no longer affects loyalty in settlements directly ruled by the king or applies stability-based relation modifiers."

"When the player clan rules a kingdom or the player is its leader, enabling this stops this mod kingdom stability from applying relation modifiers, loyalty modifiers to settlements directly ruled by the king, or kingdom-rebellion checks to that kingdom. Native low-loyalty town rebellions still follow native rules."
"Removes the configured numeric cap in active GCCZ town scenes while retaining event deduplication and queue safety."
"Limits ambient NPC replies per player utterance, semantic action, or player attack event in an active GCCZ town scene."
"Writes the separate GCCZ_Debug.log. Disabling this stops new log entries, while existing logs can still be exported or cleared."
"Records frequent diagnostics such as NPC response caps. Enable while investigating an issue; disabling this retains key logs for stage changes, disposition results, and exceptions."

literalChanges.before: "Configure GCCZ Diagnostic Log Maximum Size Megabytes."
literalChanges.after: "GCCZ_Debug.log rotates automatically at this limit; the previous file is retained as GCCZ_Debug.previous.log. Default: 16 MB."

literalChanges.before: "Open the editor or run this action."
literalChanges.after: "Copies GCCZ_Debug.log from the current module Logs folder to the desktop as a separate file with a timestamp in its name."

literalChanges.before: "Open the editor or run this action."
literalChanges.after: "Clears only the current GCCZ_Debug.log; the previous rotated log is not deleted."
"Writes the separate SETS.log for settlement-entry companions and internal unrest diagnostics. Disabling this stops new log entries, while existing logs can still be exported or cleared."

"Records frequent diagnostics such as per-frame protection, command refreshes, and troop-spawn progress. Enable while investigating stalls; disabling this retains key logs for conflict starts, waves, victories, and exceptions."

literalChanges.before: "Configure SETS Diagnostic Log Maximum Size Megabytes."
literalChanges.after: "SETS.log rotates automatically at this limit; the previous file is retained as SETS.previous.log. Default: 16 MB."

literalChanges.before: "Open the editor or run this action."
literalChanges.after: "Copies SETS.log from the current module Logs folder to the desktop as a separate file with a timestamp in its name."

literalChanges.before: "Open the editor or run this action."
literalChanges.after: "Clears only the current SETS.log; the previous rotated log is not deleted."

literalChanges.before: "Open the editor or run this action."
literalChanges.after: "Copies NoblePrisonerEscort.log to the desktop as a separate file for investigating prisoner spawning, scene executions, and retreats from wilderness meetings."

literalChanges.before: "Open the editor or run this action."
literalChanges.after: "Clears only the current NoblePrisonerEscort.log; the previous rotated log is not deleted."
"Probability that the woman becomes pregnant after the intimacy tag confirms that intercourse and internal ejaculation occurred this exchange. 0 means never, and 100 means always. Default: 50%."
